answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. This is why the network can stay open without a central gatekeeper: the economics of reputation do the filtering that a trusted authority otherwise would. Consider a marble as the anchor of the cost.
